name: City of Calgary
summary: Green Line LRT $4.9B scope cut 3x; $600M East Village TIF subsidy to private developers

findings.title: Green Line LRT — scope cuts
findings.detail: Green Line LRT reduced from 46km to 18km to 8km while budget held at $4.9B; unit cost tripled

findings.title: East Village TIF — developer subsidy
findings.detail: $600M Tax Increment Financing district primarily benefited private developer Brookfield Residential; public cost-benefit analysis never released
findings.source: Calgary Economic Development / Pembina Institute analysis 2022

findings.title: Procurement — sole-source threshold abuse
findings.detail: Audit found repeated use of sole-source exceptions for contracts just below $75K threshold
